''See also: [[The Grave Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|The [[Grave]] is a massive, industrial-style space station orbiting the central world of [[Sanctum]]. Originally constructed from repurposed components like wrecked spacecraft, destroyed buildings, and asteroid fragments, the station was built to protect an early [[Abidan]] outpost during a prehistoric war. Although it was previously known as the [[Valiant Memorial Watchtower]] and served as an [[Abidan]] museum for many generations, it is now frequently referred to by its current name. The station's exterior appears uneven and welded together, while the interior is vast enough to potentially house several cities and contains various facilities such as docks, briefing rooms, and monitoring stations. Due to the millions of lives contained within its [[steel]] structure, the station can make [[spiritual perception]] difficult for those nearby. Recent efforts have been made by [[Lindon]] and Ozriel to upgrade the station's ancient systems and remodel its interior.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|Constructed from a collection of outdated components, The [[Grave]] serves as a floating artificial mountain composed of [[stone]] and metal. This massive hovering station was originally cobbled together to protect an outpost belonging to the early [[Abidan]]. While its external surface is rough and uneven, the structure is large enough to potentially house several cities. Inside, the station consists of gray hallways, though its unique nature makes perception within the location difficult.}}
